# Superseded benchmark results

`results_fwd_v7.json` and `results_bwd_v7.json` predate the v8 normalization,
TMEM-liveness, and backward-fixture corrections. They are retained only as an
audit trail and must not be presented as paper-comparable joint-solver bars.

Current result filenames are intentionally absent until v8 schedules have
been emitted, compiled, correctness-checked, and benchmarked on B200-class
hardware.
